title: Player creations
body: Paint skins, build voxel hats and import models in the avatar editor, then wear them on any server that allows them.

title: A new main menu
body: Your worlds, favorite servers with live status, invite codes, and a living world behind it all.

title: Tools for creators
body: Make a mod from the Create tab, reload it as you save, and debug it with F8 or the web dashboard.

title: The Survival Guide
body: Press G in game for the guide book: crafting, smithing, animals, monsters and every mod's pages.
